# Prussian Blue

Prussian Blue applies a Prussian blue color palette to Obsidian's editor, panes and UI as one dark-blue workspace. Its recorded description keeps contrast clear with subtle accent tones so that text stays legible and navigation focused.

![Prussian Blue screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eddietheed/Prussian-Blue/HEAD/assets/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Prussian Blue"
    author: "eddietheed"
    repo:   "eddietheed/Prussian-Blue"
    slug:   "prussian-blue"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/prussian-blue"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/eddietheed/Prussian-Blue"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eddietheed/Prussian-Blue/HEAD/assets/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a Prussian blue color palette to Obsidian's editor, panes, and UI for a cohesive dark-blue workspace. Maintain clear contrast with subtle accent tones to keep text legible and navigation focused."
}
```
